subject: I wasn't going to share this secret betting hack
preview_text: Built something extra for you. This changes how you find value in every match. But you need to act fast.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was analyzing last weekend's Premier League data and found a pattern so obvious I'm almost embarrassed. It's the kind of edge that turns a 50/50 guess into a 70/30 lock. And I built a way for you to see it.

I created a bonus filter inside the app that highlights matches where our AI's confidence score is misleadingly low. The data says one thing, the score says another. These are the golden tickets—the value bets hiding in plain sight. Wasn't planning to release it, but your spot in the sequence lined up with a major fixture week.

Open the app, go to any league fixture list, and look for the subtle gold highlight on certain matches. Tap it. You'll see the full breakdown of why the prediction confidence is artificially depressed (often injury news the public hasn't priced in yet). This is the data beating gut feeling, naked.

Find a gold-highlighted match and tap it before the line moves. This filter is live for the next 48 hours for your account only. P.S. The Man City vs Arsenal preview? One of the matches is glowing. You didn't hear it from me.
